Clean lines and sturdy tapered legs give them a handsome presence at a dining room table, in a living area or behind a desk. 26.8"W x 23.2"D x 32.2"H Top-grain leather; Solid hardwood frame and legs Foam padding and elastic suspension system keep back and seat firm Easy assembly in 15 minutes.
